author: official
summary: Adds a visitor inbox bubble for a site or other tenant, with an optional site-answer view.

attributes.name: data-kind
attributes.description: Tenant kind: site, card, cardtile, or ext.

attributes.name: data-id
attributes.description: Tenant key for the selected kind.

attributes.name: data-kaito
attributes.description: Set to 1 to enable the site-answer view.

attributes.name: data-assistant-name
attributes.description: Baked assistant name until the platform resolves its current value.

attributes.name: data-open-on-hash
attributes.description: Set to 1 to let #inbox open the panel.

attributes.name: data-ai-log
attributes.description: Set to 0 to disable the deferred question log.

attributes.name: data-status
attributes.description: Visible status line when the site-answer view is off.

attributes.name: data-site-name
attributes.description: Baked site name when the platform has not resolved one.
